_comment: Performance budgets for the Wata Board performance-monitoring pipeline (issue #375). Values are advisory by default: the CI dashboard reports ✅/⚠️/❌ but does not fail the build on absolute-budget breaches. Set repo variable PERF_ENFORCE=true (or run the workflow with enforce=true) to make hard-budget breaches fail the job. Regressions vs. the PR base branch are surfaced automatically by the bundle-size job. Tighten these numbers as the app is optimised.

regression._comment: Thresholds used by the bundle-size (vs base) job. minimum-change-threshold is in bytes.
